commentary: Market breadth score stands at 50 with the scanner gate at CAUTION despite the euphoric 576-point Nifty rebound driven by softer crude and foreign inflows. Under Stan Weinstein's stage discipline and William O'Neil's market-direction guidelines, a single powerful rally after extensive correction requires confirmation through follow-through and institutional accumulation. Mark Minervini's progressive exposure dictates that capital must only be risked on confirmed Stage 2 leaders emerging from tight volatility contraction or proper base breakouts with verifiable earnings acceleration (C+A). Laggards and structurally unprofitable names must be weeded out, while setups lacking institutional quarterly growth are strictly capped at Watch until systematic accumulation proves broad-market health.

analysis.analyst: SEPA / CANSLIM / Stage Analysis (Minervini, O'Neil, Weinstein)

63MOONS.technical: Consolidating in a 23.3% deep cup-and-handle base with a 6.8% upper-half handle above 21-EMA, 50-DMA, and 200-DMA. RSI at 53 indicates balanced momentum ahead of the 982.83 trigger.
63MOONS.fundamental: Top-line revenue expanded 81.9% YoY, but persistent operational deficits and a net loss of ₹48 crore erode fundamental quality. Negative ROCE (-3.7%) and ROE (-2.0%) fail CANSLIM criteria.
63MOONS.risk: Strict stop at 880.20; breakdown below handle low or the 50-DMA invalidates the base structure.

AAREYDRUGS.technical: Developing a double-bottom base with neckline resistance at 114.91, reclaiming 21-EMA, 50-DMA, and 200-DMA. Bullish engulfing candle offers short-term support, though overhead supply remains heavy.
AAREYDRUGS.fundamental: Quarterly sales collapsed 55.4% YoY alongside anemic operating margins near 1.5% and low 2.8% ROE. Extended receivable days and sluggish operational cash flows miss CANSLIM requirements.
AAREYDRUGS.risk: Failure to hold 103.61 stop or loss of the double-bottom swing pivot aborts the pattern.

ACUTAAS.technical: Powerful Stage 2 advance trending above rising 21-EMA, 50-DMA, and 200-DMA. Resolving a double-bottom continuation pivot at 4049.35 with strong relative strength and RSI at 68.
ACUTAAS.fundamental: Elite institutional growth backed by CDMO and pharma intermediates. EBITDA margin expanded 914 bps YoY to 40.3%, ROE reached 24%, ROCE is 31.6%, supported by zero debt and zero pledge.
ACUTAAS.risk: Stop discipline at 3637.50; thesis breaks on CDMO contract delays or compression of high valuation multiples.

ADANIGREEN.technical: Cleared a 20-day high at 1417.42, maintaining alignment above rising 21-EMA, 50-DMA, and 200-DMA. MACD remains positive and RSI 59 indicates constructive momentum without immediate exhaustion.
ADANIGREEN.fundamental: Sales surged 43.1% YoY with high operating margins (~89%), but massive interest expenses (₹2,119 crore quarterly) dampen bottom-line net profit. EPS growth slowed to 16%, limiting ROCE to 7.4%.
ADANIGREEN.risk: Exit strictly on breach of 1329.50 stop; thesis fails if heavy financing costs breach 50-DMA support.

ADANIPORTS.technical: Classic Stage 2 continuation breakout clearing 20-day and 52-week highs on 1.29x average volume. Moving averages (21-EMA, 50-DMA, 200-DMA) are stacked in ideal bullish alignment.
ADANIPORTS.fundamental: Port cargo volume and logistics scale drove 17.4% top-line growth with ~59% operating margins and 16.4% ROE. However, single-digit EPS growth (+9%) fails O'Neil's 25% threshold, capping rating.
ADANIPORTS.risk: Stop at 1776.35; thesis terminates if global trade volumes contract or the breakout reverses below support.

AEROFLEX.technical: Constructive double-bottom base with a 3-up sequence off 21-EMA/50-DMA pullback, clearing 614.31. Moving averages trend higher and positive MACD confirms strong institutional sponsorship.
AEROFLEX.fundamental: Data-center liquid cooling demand drove Q2 revenue up 87% YoY and net profit up 157% YoY. EBITDA margin widened to 24.3%, balance sheet is virtually debt-free, with 0% promoter pledge.
AEROFLEX.risk: Stop at 529.97; thesis breaks if ₹202 crore capex execution stumbles or volume dries up on breakout.
